fact: On 8 October 2026 the Gabonese Council of Ministers adopted a bill ratifying and amending ordinance 0002/PR/2026 of 26 February 2026 on digital payment rules, conforming to CEMAC payment regulation and promoting interoperability with regional and international systems; the text names no central bank role.
title: Gabon : le Gouvernement veut renforcer le cadre juridique des paiements digitaux
